product.description: Workstream™ by Monoprice™Desk Mount C‑Shaped Surge Protector6 AC outlets, plus two USB‑A and one USB‑C® charging portsThis easy to mount desktop surge protector helps office workers and students with powering, charging, and protecting their computers and electronic devices, while at their desks or workstations.Protect your electronics and extend their useful life by shielding them against transient voltage spikes with 1080 joules of protection. Power surges commonly affect households and buildings from external sources, such as indirect lightning strikes, grid switching, and power outages, or from internal sources, like from air conditioners, refrigerators, and washers and dryers switching on or off. The integrated 15 amp resettable circuit breaker is designed to instantly protect against overloads and short circuits. The LED indicator light shows that electronics are protected and the auto‑shutoff feature cuts power to AC devices, once surge protection is fully consumed.This surge protector provides convenient power distribution and is easy to install on a desk. It features a unique C‑shaped design, with a built‑in spring clamp for easy mounting. Six sockets on the lower arm make it easy to distribute power to electronics, while keeping the plugs hidden. The USB‑C and USB‑A charge ports on the upper arm provide easily access for charging mobile device.C‑shaped design mounts to the edge of a desk or workstationSpring‑loaded pressure arm keeps the surge protector in place1080 Joules of surge protectionBuilt‑in circuit breaker switchEasy access to two USB‑A and one USB‑C® charging portsSix AC outlets on lower armC‑SHAPED DESIGN WITH SPRING‑LOADED PRESSURE ARMThe C‑shaped design easily mounts to the edge of a desk, workstation, or even a cubicle divider! The spring‑loaded pressure arm keeps the surge protector from sliding around. BUILT‑IN MOBILE DEVICE CHARGINGThe upper arm features two USB-A and one USB‑C® charging ports to keep your mobile devices full charged and ready for use. The USB‑A ports can deliver up to 2.4A of charging power each (4.8A total), while the USB‑C® port can deliver up to 3A/15W of charging power.PROTECTION FOR ELECTRONICSThis surge protector provides 1080 Joules of overall protection and features a built‑in circuit breaker switch for over current protection.
